Every assistant message automatically: translate on demand → synthesize with the selected TTS → auto
-play, with a 🔊/⏸/▶ button (play / pause / resume / replay) at the end of the message.
- **Conditional translation**: only calls the translation API when `voiceLanguage` ≠ `aiLanguage`; o

therwise the original text is synthesized directly
- **OpenAI-compatible translation**: configurable
`baseUrl` / `model` / `apiKey` (DeepSeek by default; switch to OpenAI by changing `baseUrl`/`model`

)

- **autoStart**: automatically starts local TTS servi

ces on plugin activation (health-checked, never starts duplicates)
- **Long text**: chunks by each p
rovider's `maxChunk` and stitches the audio together
